name: Luminus Devices
old_description: High-output LED chips and COB arrays for lighting, horticulture, entertainment
about:
Luminus Devices is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, where it develops and manufactures high-output LED chips and chip-on-board (COB) arrays for a range of lighting and photonics applications. The company operates as a manufacturer of illumination, specialty, and laser diode products, serving global markets through a network of local, regional, and international distributors.

Its product portfolio spans illumination LEDs for retail, hospitality, residential, industrial, outdoor, office, education, museum, and architectural settings, including circadian and human-centric lighting. Specialty lines cover ultraviolet, stage and studio, infrared, projection and display, horticulture, medical and life sciences, and automotive applications. The company also produces lasers and power products such as MOSFETs and Schottky barrier diodes. Recent releases include the SFT-70X high-CRI LED, LUX Pro and Gen6+ COB platforms, CFT-50X series for medical and industrial use, and deep-red SFT-12R and SFT-25R LEDs for stage and horticulture. Online tools such as a horticulture calculator and lumen calculators for COB and mid-power arrays support customer design work.

Luminus serves fixture manufacturers, lighting designers, and OEMs across general lighting, horticulture, entertainment, medical, life sciences, automotive, industrial, and projection/display sectors. Collaborations with partners like BluGlass, Current Chemicals, and Cuvée Systems extend its technology reach, including KSF phosphor licensing and joint driver development.

The company emphasizes efficacy, color quality, and real-world performance, citing breakthroughs such as breaking the $0.10 per milliwatt barrier for UVC LEDs and introducing Salud™ COBs with high melanopic-to-photopic ratios for healthy daytime lighting. Proprietary Robusto™ technology enables high-density COB arrays, while KSF phosphor technology enhances color rendering across its product lines.
